description: Current Harris County parcel identity audit; runtime held because account numbers do not uniquely identify geometry.

identity.objectId: OBJECTID is the service row identifier, not used as durable cadastral identity. No GlobalID is supplied.

nextRequirement: Establish official semantics for split/multi-part account records and a durable parcel entity before registering a provider; do not silently select the first polygon or expose OBJECTID as its cadastral key.
